offers_products.reason: Sells DonJoy braces, Aircast boots, Compex stimulators, Chattanooga rehab equipment and Enovis Surgical hip, knee and shoulder implants.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from medical devices and implants; services are incidental support to products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Compex, Dr. Comfort and DonJoy braces and shoes are bought by patients and athletes, also retail.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells implants to hospitals and surgeons, and rehab equipment to clinics and distributors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly per-procedure implants and one-off brace or device purchases, though repeat orders from clinics and distributors occur.

cyclical_demand.reason: Orthopedic implants, braces and rehab devices serve medical needs, though elective surgery can be deferred somewhat.

big_ticket.reason: Braces, rehab devices and stimulators are typically modest purchases; implants are bought by hospitals as routine supplies.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured medical devices and implants, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are clinicians, clinics, surgeons, distributors and consumers; hospital buyers are mixed, not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs and sells orthopedic devices and implants; manufacturing is moderate, not utility- or fleet-style heavy investment.

notes: Enovis recently focuses on Recon (surgical implants) and Prevention & Recovery (bracing, rehab); answers weigh bracing and implants together.
